plugins.name: pr-review-kit
plugins.description: Context-first pull-request review: blast-radius briefing, draft-by-default review submission, and a printable PDF dossier for judging each comment before it is published.

plugins.name: amd-gpu
plugins.description: Software development on AMD GPUs: the ROCm and HIP toolchain, CDNA kernel performance work, and assembly-level analysis. Each skill states the architectures it covers.

plugins.name: code-study
plugins.description: Turn code you did not write into a diagram-first verified PDF study -- one algorithm implementation, or a whole system's architecture -- or into a verified PPTX tutorial on one topic. Every claim is cited, derived, or measured.

plugins.name: agent-team
plugins.description: Autonomous multi-agent development over a GitHub issue pool: briefs, developer and reviewer agents looping to APPROVE, squash landing behind tree checks, and an owner-only need human stop. Plus gh-prose, a style guide and lint for GitHub text.

plugins.name: auto-grilling
plugins.description: Grill a plan without stopping: every question answered with its recommended answer, every decision logged with its strongest rejected alternative and a confidence, then one final menu to write a document, write code, hand off to /agent-team plan, revise, or end.
